verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.warp.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing Warp's docs for agents. Section-level agent-oriented text files are also published under docs.warp.dev/_llms-txt/ (e.g. warp-agent-cli.txt, automation-platform.txt, api--reference.txt), along with a machine-readable openapi.json. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explaining how agents should consume llms.txt, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually being pointed at these docs.
